segments.text: Itsuki is a second year student and a classmate of Shuuji, Shinobu, Aoi and Kouichi. She is also Shinobu's best friend and one of the best swimmers in the swim club. With pretty curves and a pretty face, Itsuki is considered as the most beautiful girl in the school and is the target of all boys.

One day, while a Senpai was heavily seducing her behind the school gym, Shuuji came to get her out of there pretending to have asked her for an appointment to see her in private. Playing the games, Itsuki joined Shuuji, smiling and happy, sending the Senpai away. However, Shinobu attended (from afar) the scene and thinked that Itsuki and Shuuji were dating, spreading the rumor in all the school.

Taking advantage of the opportunity to scare the boys, Itsuki asks Shuuji if he agrees to play the game and claim to be her boyfriend, which he does because he sees no problem helping his classmate, thus becoming the most watched and envied man of the high school.

Although she and Shuuji feign their relationship, she really wants to become his friend and get to know him better without taking into account the prejudices of his reputation as a fighter. She is very friendly with others so she makes friends very fast, even with Aoi although it's after she has discovered that she is in fact a sex bomb.

Itsuki is very feminine and likes to dress to look very cute. She is a bit of a nuisance, but she quickly loses her ability when someone has sincerely complimented her. Also, she is very weak against cute things, so when she meets Konomi, Itsuki melts of love in front of her.

Even if they are only friends, Itsuki is a little jealous to hear Shuuji call Aoi by her first name and that he doesn't do it with her. She even develops a sort of inferiority complex to Aoi and Amane, who have a divine gift for cooking, who have generous forms and are much sexier than her.

In her route, at the end of a date, Shuuji decides to unveil his past to her, where he was sad and lonely. She then takes his hands telling him that now she will always be at his side, as a friend. It is at this moment that their relationship begins to change.

Some time later, Shuuji asked to have a date with her before the fireworks of the festival of Tanabata, which she decided to spend the festival with her Senpais from the swimming club. During the festival, Itsuki decides to leave her Senpais to finally join Shuuji but she surprises Amane approaching Shuuji and telling him that she wants to clarify their relationship.
At that moment, Itsuki understands that she is in love with Shuuji but decides to hold back her feelings and try to put Amane and Shuuji back together.
学園内でも名前が通るほどの美少女。
ただし誰かと付き合っているという事は無かった。
ただある日、あまり性質のよろしく無い上級生に無理矢理言い寄られている所を主人公が助ける。
そのお陰で、「付き合いだした」という噂が学園中に広まってしまうがそういった男が多くて面倒だったという事もあり、ウソの恋人生活を続ける事になる。
そしてせめてもの恩返しにあれやこれやと世話を焼いて行く事になる。

誰かと付き合っているということは無く、ある日、あまりタチのよろしくない上級生に無理矢理言い寄られてしまう。
そして通りがかった主人公に、「俺の彼女に何してるんですか」 と助けられる。
このおかげで、“主人公と付き合いだした” という噂が学園中に広まってしまう。

せめてもの恩返しにと、あれやこれやと世話を焼き始める。
「私に任せなさい」

Aoi is the little sister of Tsubame and the cousin of Shuuji who's living together with them. She is a second year student and is the classmate of Shuuji, Kouichi, Itsuki and Shinobu. She is also a childhood friend of Amane. Seeing that her cousin was in a problematic situation, she has consulted with Tsubame and picked Shuuji up to live with them. She is very close to Konomi and her policy is "there's no need to work hard".

Aoi is a girl who has a double life, she is very lonely and reserved for school, dressing so as not to show off, wearing glasses, tying her hair, with the label of the serious and boring student, which means that she has no friends at school, even coldly avoiding her cousin when they meet in class. Outside, Aoi is another girl: she is a stylish and a famous model knowed as Shirai Sumire (白井 スミレ) with a shoulder-length bob and is very sexy. At home, Aoi is much more relaxed. Wearing revealing clothes as pajamas and playing retro games in the living room (his favorite game is Pokevy, a very long game that has no backup function). When Aoi learns that Shuuji is in a relationship with Itsuki, she picks him up in the living room and orders him to explain.

The relationship that Aoi and Shuuji maintain is similar to a relationship between siblings. They heckle, make derogatory remarks and tease each other all the time. However, Aoi loves Shuuji very much, like her brother, and this love is reciprocal. She is ready to do anything for him if he has problems. She has no embarrassment with Shuuji because she doesn't see him at all as a potential lover of the opposite sex, even asking him how he does to "endure" his impulses since he lives alone with two pretty girls. She even thinks that Shuuji fantasizes about Tsubame because he always looks "discreetly" the breasts, buttocks and thighs of her sister.
Aoi thinks a lot about the future, wondering what she'll do the day where her sister will leaves home or thinking about her futur marriage.

She believes that Shuuji is no longer a virgin since he was Amane's boyfriend for a while before separating. She is very surprised to learn the opposite, calling him a hetare or telling him he must be gay because he has been hanging out with Kouichi for over a year, playing video games in his room.

Young, Aoi was obese and was martyred by the boys at her school. She decided to go on a diet and she lost weight when she entered in middle school. At the same time, Aoi had three cups more than her classmates, attracting boys who once mocked her. She is currently wearing F cup and and is always sensitive to comments concerning her physique.

In her route, Shuuji accidentally enters the bathroom while she is there and he sees her wearing sexy underwear. Aoi kindly asks him to go out because she knows that he didn't go into the bathroom on purpose but she realizes that Shuuji is all red and that something unusual happens so she asks him to wait for her in the living room. Once in the living she asks him for explanations and Shuuji answers her honestly that he didn't know she was in the bathroom but when he saw her in her sexy underwear, he couldn't help but to see her as a magnificent woman. Aoi is very embarrassed because she knows that Shuuji has told what he really thinks so she doesn't know how to react. She then tells him that it's not that bad and they shouldn't think about it anymore. Except that the damage is already done and Aoi's feelings are starting to change.
主人公の従姉。現在は姉と二人暮らし。
色々と問題のあった主人公を見かねて、姉と相談し引き取る事に。
基本的に「頑張らなくて良い」派。
しかし自身は引きこもり気味の、完全インドア趣味。
人とつるむ事が苦手で、社交性はかなり低い。
家では気を抜いて完全に自堕落。
主人公の前でも露出が多かったり、下着が見えたりしている。
その癖、時折無防備にスキンシップをはかってくるので、主人公の心臓に悪い。
主人公の従姉。 同じクラスで 2年生。
両親は祖父母の面倒を見るために田舎で生活しており、現在は姉と二人暮らし。

そのくせ無防備にスキンシップをはかってくるので、主人公の心臓に悪い。
「私を巻き込まないでくれるかなあ」

Konomi is in her last year of middle school and is the step sister of Shuuji. She practices judo as Shuuji did before with Amane as a mentor. Unlike Nadeshiko, Konomi gets along well with Shuuji, she loves her new family and she worries a lot about him, who does not give her any news since he left. Her real father has also deceased, but Konomi is straightforward and does her best in this hard situation. She's doing her best to do something about the cold relationship between her mother and her step brother. She's admirably well-behaved and calm, but she her personality has a strong base and she acts whenever needed.
Aside from her family, Konomi loves Amane and Aoi a lot and she would like to one day be able to cook as well as they do.

She is a very innocent and naive girl. Pretty shy, she doesn't dare to impose too much to say what she thinks. To help her get some insurance, Amane trains her to Judo herself and that helps her to at least have the courage to speak to other peoples.

Two or three years ago, she used to go to Shuuji's room to read manga or light novels on his bed. Also nowadays, Konomi doesn't have a particular hobby except staying in her room to read manga, which suggests she must be very alone.
She has frequent and long verbal arguments with Nadeshiko regarding her academic orientation and regarding how is her mother's relationship with Shuuji.

In her route, after a very violent argument with her mother, Konomi runs away from her home and goes to Amane's house for her to take her to Shuuji's house. Once towards him, Shuuji told him to go to her room so that she would take a book as they did before, which she does. Looking for the rest of the manga she used to read, she comes across an adult manga that she begins to read out of curiosity. Shuuji then enters the room and Konomi panics a little. After explaining some things to him, Konomi told him with embarrassment that if he really needed to relieve himself, that she would help him and that he did not need to worry because they did not have any blood kinship.
Over time, Konomi's character is more and more like her mother. According to Nadeshio, Konomi even looks like her physically when she was the same age.
主人公の父の再婚相手の連れ子。
主人公と血のつながりは無い義妹。
彼女も実父を亡くしているが、境遇に負けぬ真っ直ぐな子で、新しい家族の事も好き。
優しく、気をつかってくれる兄の事は好きなので、母親と義兄の仲が冷えている事をどうにかしたいと思っている。
健気で大人しいが、芯が強く必要であれば行動する。
パターンを変えようの無い美少女
主人公の父の再婚相手の連れ子。 血の繋がりは無い義妹。
健気でおとなしいが、芯が強く必要であれば積極的に行動する。
実父を亡くしているが境遇に負けない真っ直ぐな子で、新しい家族のことも好き。
優しく気を遣ってくれる兄のことは好きなので、母親と義兄の仲が冷えていることをどうにかしたいと思っている。
「わたしは、お兄ちゃんを信じてるよ」

Amane is the daughter of the Judo Dōjō's master where Shuuji used to learn. She was there was her eldest and so her mentor. Nowaday, she is a third-year student and is close to a high school not far from Konomi's middle school, who is now her apprentice at the dōjō. She's foul-mouthed and calmly spits abusive language at people because of which she isn't popular despite her great looks.

A few years ago, Shuuji badly wounded her in the left leg during a fight and she had to be operated because the wound was severe. During her convalescence in the hospital, Shuuji decided to go see her and go to confess her feelings for her with a bouquet of flowers and that's how they started to go out together.

Because of her injury, Amane can no longer fight and can no longer compete in judo competitions. After a few years, Amane broke her relationship with Shuuji because he did not treat her like a girlfriend (the only "intimate" thing that Shuuji had done to her was to massage her shoulders and back) but they remained good friends.

One day, as she was returning home, Amane was surrounded by thugs who wanted to force her to have sex with them. Unable to fight, Amane was in a bad situation. Shuuji then intervened so that the thugs give up the case, but one of them then left a knife. Shuuji then attacked the first and made a real carnage by exploding them violently. Because of this incident, Shuuji was excommunicated from the dōjō in front of all the students because he violated the rules of judo and has used it to attack people (even if it was justified). It was the last time he saw Amane before seeing her again, when she takes her protégé Konomi to see how her step brother is, at Aoi's house the following year.
The dōjō of her family works so well that he even attracts police officers who come to train. Thanks to that, Amane's family is quite wealthy, and they have many cars in their garage.
Amane has a great passion for driving, she passed her driving license not long ago. She always does judo, but only gives lessons with her father and doesn't fight.
She is the most popular girl in her high school, but no boys approach her because she sends them away violently.

Amane didn't leave Shuuji because she didn't love him anymore, on the contrary, she still loves him very much. She left Shuuji because she felt very upset that he never tried to have sex with her, or even to kiss her at least one time. Her pride took a big hit and she thought it was her lack of coquetry that was the culprit (in addition to Shuuji's lack of courage) so she decided to become more feminine before seeing him again. When she comes back to see him in Aoi's house and sees that he is with Itsuki, she is certain that he doesn't actually go out with her, but she keeps it to herself.

On the contrary, she realizes that Shuuji is very attractive for the other girls too, she even begins to believe that Shuuji slept with Aoi, Itsuki or someone else. Also realizing that Shuuji could fall in love with another girl, Amane promises to herself not to get in their way and lets things happen, however, if she sees that Shuuji is not interested in any of the other girls he frequents, she will not hesitate to take him for her.
主人公が通っていた格闘技（柔道）の道場主の娘。
色々あって主人公と恋人同士になる。
が、ある事をきっかけに付き合いも自然消滅していった―― と、思っていたが…。
基本的に口が悪い。静かに毒を吐くタイプでその相手を選ばないので見た目は美人でも人気は無い。
観賞用美人。

色々あって主人公と恋人同士になるが、あることをキッカケに付き合いも自然消滅していった―― と、思っていたが……
「動きが悪いにしても、少しは自分の頭を使ったら？」

Shuuji is a second year student and is the cousin of Aoi and Tsubame. He is also the step brother of Konomi and the childhood friend of Amane, who is also his ex-girlfriend. He left the family home two years ago because he doesn't get along with his father any more and for a year he has been living with his cousins.

Since he joined Aoi's high school, his only friend has been Kouichi (because he doesn't have a very good reputation), with whom he shares a passion for strategy games. He is also a classmate of Itsuki and Shinobu.

One day, he surprised a Senpai who was heavily and ungraciously seducing his classmate Itsuki and he decided to get her out of there pretending to have asked her for an appointment to see her in private. Playing the games, Itsuki joined Shuuji, smiling and happy, sending the Senpai away. However, Shinobu attended (from afar) the scene and thinked that Itsuki and Shuuji were dating, spreading the rumor in all the school.

Taking advantage of the opportunity to scare the boys, Itsuki asks Shuuji if he agrees to play the game and claim to be her boyfriend, which he does because he sees no problem helping his classmate, thus becoming the most watched and envied man of the high school. At the end of the day, returning home, Aoi picks him up in the living room and orders him to explain everything. Shuuji then tells him that he claims to be his boyfriend to help his classmate and that there is nothing more between them.

Many things happen, and Shuuji finds himself with Itsuki at his side in front of his little sister Konomi and childhood friend Amane who came to see him. The situation is complicated for the false couple of lovers and the stability of their secret hangs by a thread.
Shuuji wants to be independent as soon as possible. For this, he works part-time at the bar-restaurant of the shopping center, the Comeria.

The relationship that Aoi and Shuuji maintain is similar to a relationship between siblings. They heckle, make derogatory remarks and tease each other all the time. However, Shuuji loves Aoi very much, like his sister, and this love is reciprocal. He is ready to do anything for her if she has problems.
Shuuji never gets sick, or very rarely.

Shuuji's father died a year ago, and he struggles to recover because the last time he saw him they had quarreled because Shuuji didn't accept and find disrespectful that his father remarried with Nadeshiko less than a year after his mother's death so Shuuji had left the house.
Shuuji greatly respects girls and does not want to rush their first time, even if he is deeply in love with her, he prefers to wait until she is ready.

He doesn't masturbate anymore since he lives with his cousins because he is too afraid to be surprised by either Aoi or Tsubame who enter in his room as if it was theirs. Once, at the beginning of their cohabitation, Aoi entered in his room while he was about to ejaculate. He managed to restrain from relieving himself and, at the same time, hiding the fact that he was masturbating. When Aoi loses one of her panties, she always accuses him having masturbated with but it's completely false since he is too afraid to masturbate even when he is alone.

Konomi's mother and Shuuji's stepmother from Kimio's second marriage. She is a woman of action who gets everything she wants thanks to her perseverance. She is very involved in her work and has a high position, so she makes a lot of money. Because she was full of expectations and worry about Konomi, she failed to establish a connection with Shuuji.

Nadeshiko is a true modern woman: independent and with a strong character. She is very frank and strict with herself and demands the same from others in counterpart. However, she has no household skills.
Although she has quite weak mentality, she isn't a bad person at heart. Rather, she is deeply emotional and clumsy, which is why she is always at edge.

When she lost her first husband, Nadeshiko almost lost her desire to live, having only Konomi as the only will to live. At the bottom of the hole, Kimio "saved" her. Over time, she fell in love with him and remarried with him. Upon Kimio's death, she swore to respect her commitments as the mother of Seto family for her two children.
She sincerely regrets that she didn't succeed to becoming a mother for Shuuji, but that doesn't stop her from doing everything to look after him.

Aoi's older sister, Shuuji's older cousin and she works at a company that makes videos for television and is also Aoi's manager. Her parents are away from home because they left to take care of the grandfather who lives in the countryside.

After consulting with Aoi, she decided to take Shuuji in. She is often absent because of her job so she relies a lot on Aoi to take care of Shuuji and when she is at home, she mostly sleeps. She doesn't seem like a person who's taking things very seriously.
Sometimes in the evening, when Shuuji works at Comeria, she goes to see him and to eat with Aoi and spend some time with them.

She sometimes stays at parties between colleagues at the end of the day and because of her looks she receives invitations to become a model for related companies, but she herself isn't eager to do it. Also at these parties, she can hear many men models who want to "go out" (at least for one night) with Aoi.

She sincerely thinks that Aoi will take care of Shuuji and that if one day Shuuji wants to "attack" Aoi, she would very easily put him back in place (Shuuji is a healthy young man living with two pretty girls after all, so they must be wary) so in Aoi's route, she is very surprised to find that it's Aoi who "sexually" attacked Shuuji and lead their fraternal relationship to a romantic relationship. However, even if she is a little troubled by this change, she only imposes one thing on Aoi and Shuuji: use contraceptives at least until graduation.

Shinobu is Itsuki's best friend who does her best to follow-up after Itsuki makes some kind of silly mistake. She is second year student and is the classmate of Itsuki, Shuuji, Aoi and Kouichi. Shinobu is also part of a swimming club but she doesn't swim because she has a poor health so she assists the swimmers in noting their times.

By accident, she saw Shuuji save Itsuki who was with an insistent Senpai who wanted to take her for a ride in the pink district of the city. Seeing Itsuki going to Shuuji in a friendly way, she misunderstands. Very happy that her friend has finally got a boyfriend , she has spread the rumor that "Itsuki and Shuuji go out together".
From time to time she tries to probe onto the two's relationship while making sure they don't break up and thinks that "it's good that Itsuki got a boyfriend".

Kouichi is a second year student and Shuuji's first friend since he arrived in high school and is also his classmate with Itsuki, Shinobu and Aoi. Intelligent and voluntary in high school life, Kouichi has the reputation of a very serious student.

Like many, he had heard of the violent reputation of the Demon of Hayabara, a lonely brawler. However, he and Shuuji quickly became sympathetic the day they met outside of school in a video game store. Sharing the same passion, Kouichi spent all his free time playing strategy games in Shuuji's room, which gave rise to an unpleasant rumor that they were in a relationship.
Like many boys at school, he is jealous that Itsuki, the most beautiful girl in the school, has become his girlfriend.
Surprisingly, though, having spent more than a year playing video games in Shuuji's room, Kouichi never noticed that his friend and Aoi were cousins and lived under the same roof.
Knowing Shuuji and having a great experience of Otome games, he is one of the first to wonder if Shuuji's relationship with Itsuki is really real.
Kimio's first wife and the mother of Shuuji. She died as a result of a degenerative disease.

Very kind and loving, she was a housewife who looked after Shuuji all the time, calling him her treasure. She was excellent in all housework and taught her son how to cook for people who are very valuable to them.
She was also very close to her nieces Tsubame and Aoi. They played a lot together.

Her illness made her lose weight a lot, she gradually lost her muscle mass and also lost her fertility. At the beginning of the "terminal phase", Akio was exhausted and she suffered a lot. However, she had accepted the fact that she was going to die and told honestly to her beloved son that she was going to die, the only thing she was hiding from him was the constant pain she felt.
Despite her indescribable suffering, she spent as much time as possible at home offering the most "happy" memories of her to Shuuji who was alone at home.
One of her last wishes was that Kimio and Shuuji do everything they can to be happy after her death.
Shuuji's father, former husband of Aki (widower) and the new husband of Nadeshiko. A man very busy with his work and not very present at home.

Less than a year after Akio's death, he remarried with Nadeshiko, who also lost her husband a few times before. She is (very shortly after she was introduced to Shuuji) came to live with her daughter Konomi (whom she had from her first marriage) in the Seto house.

Because of this far too fast remarriage and other factors, Shuuji and he do not maintain a good relationship and argue all the time. Because of tensions, Shuuji has been away from home for the last two years.
In fact, Kimio has been dead for a year, probably dead of sorrow.

When Akio was diagnosed to be dying, Kimio could not accept it. Seeing every day his wife wither more and more, he took refuge in his work. When Akio died, Kimio reached the bottom of the hole and was depressed a lot. It was in these conditions that he met Nadeshiko who lived the same thing as him, but taking care of him even less than him. Kimio then extended his hand to Nadeshiko to get him out of the hell of denial, as Aoi did for Shuuji after Kimio's death.
After a few months of support, Kimio and Nadeshko began to fall in love and decided to get married.
Amane's father and the master of the Dōjō. Very attached to the values of judo, the father of Amane is very traditional and quite strict with his pupils as for the respect of the rules of the judo.
When Shuuji broke the rules of judo using his martial knowledge for aggression, he excommunicated him from the Dōjō even though the aggression was justified.

He is grateful that Shuuji is protected Amane from the delinquents who wanted to assault him and is sorry to have excommunicated him from the Dōjō. However, he is quite ready to give him a second chance when Amane reintroduces him into the Dōjō sometime later.
Dean of the Dōjō and Amane's grandfather.

Although he is too old to give judo lessons himself, he attends classes so that he can ensure that the rules are not violated. He also serves as a judge when there is a conflict between the mentor and the apprentices.
Just as traditional as his son, he is however more tender with the students even if he knows how to be authoritarian and severe.

In Amane's route, Shuuji confided to him some embarrassing things about the evolution of his relationship with Amane. In response, the dean (happy and smiling) asks Shuuji to take good care of his granddaughter.
